project.name: Roland XPS-30 Study and Setup Plan
project.objective: Create a complete knowledge base, configuration guide, and optimized setup for a Roland XPS-30 focused on Christian worship, live performance, and long-term mastery.

goals: Master every feature of the Roland XPS-30.
Understand the synthesis architecture instead of only memorizing buttons.
Keep all documentation under version control.
Avoid dependence on Windows whenever possible.

deliverables.name: Knowledge Base
deliverables.description: Complete documentation explaining the XPS-30 architecture, features, terminology, and workflow.

deliverables.name: Study Plan
deliverables.description: Progressive study roadmap from beginner to advanced.

deliverables.name: Sound Library
deliverables.description: Catalog of useful sounds, favorites, performances, and expansion recommendations.

deliverables.name: Linux Guide
deliverables.description: How to manage expansions, backups, and samples using Ubuntu where possible.
